# oregoninsuranceappraiser.com — static site

**Oregon Insurance Appraiser**: a static site (no database, no plugins) generated by a Python script and
served by a small PHP front controller plus a canonical-host guard on a Hostinger Agency Growth website.
Engineering was copied from `georgiainsuranceappraiser/` (generator, `validate.py`, `deploy.sh`,
`api/contact.php`, tool logic, guard); the content, URL slugs and design are new.

| Path | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `build.py` | Generator: layout, homepage, page templates, schema, sitemap, `index.php`, `_guard.php`, Search Console file |
| `src/services.py` | 12 service pages (one main keyword each, `kw`) |
| `src/locations.py` | 12 city pages (county, neighborhoods, storm history, housing mix) |
| `src/tools.py` | 7 interactive tools (markup + copy); logic in `static/assets/js/app.js` |
| `src/learn.py` | Process guide, grouped FAQ, 44-term glossary, 6 guide articles |
| `src/photos.json` | Photo manifest: source URL, license, creator, size, alt (internal record only) |
| `src/photomap.py` | Which photo goes on which page |
| `static/` | CSS, JS, icons, OG image, photos, `api/contact.php` — copied into `public/` as-is |
| `public/` | **Build output, committed, deployed.** |
| `validate.py` | Post-build checks (must exit 0) |
| `deploy.sh` | Uploads `public/` to `public_html` over the File Browser TUS API |
| `tools/make_icons.py` | Favicon pipeline (svg, ico 16/32/48 bold, 96 png, 180 apple-touch, maskable 192/512, manifest) |
| `tools/fetch_photos.py` | Photo pipeline: download picked CC0/PD originals one at a time → 1200px + 640px WebP + manifest |
| `tools/make_og.py` | 1200×630 OG image from a site photo |
| `tools/router.php` | Local router that mimics the host (for guard/redirect tests) |
| `tools/qa.js` | Playwright QA (overflow, images, console errors, tool math, drawer, logo hover, no-JS) |

## Build & deploy

```sh
python3 build.py && python3 validate.py
```

```sh
# credentials from the Hostinger API: agency-hosting_files_generate-upload-url (website_uid k9Oyg28hx); they expire in a few hours
export OIA_FB_URL='https://…/api/tus' OIA_FB_AUTH='…' OIA_FB_REST='…'
./deploy.sh        # then agency-hosting_cache_clear-website (website_uid k9Oyg28hx)
```

`deploy.sh` only adds and overwrites (it never uploads `api/_private/`). If a page is removed or renamed, delete the
old file on the server: `DELETE ${OIA_FB_URL%/tus}/resources/public_html/<path>` with the same `X-Auth` /
`X-Auth-Rest` headers. Hostinger's placeholder `public_html/default.php` was deleted on first deploy.

Local test: `php -S 127.0.0.1:8080 -t public tools/router.php`, then `node tools/qa.js http://127.0.0.1:8080 /tmp/qa`.

## Hosting notes (why pages are `dir/index.php`)

- The host ignores `.htaccess`, has no Agency-plan "force HTTPS" switch, and **serves real files directly without
  running the root `index.php`**. A `dir/index.html` page would skip any redirect, so `http://www.…/page/` would load
  with a 200.
- So every page is `dir/index.php` whose first line is `<?php require_once dirname(__DIR__, n) . '/_guard.php'; ?>`
  followed by static HTML with no other PHP. The homepage is `home.html`, served by the front controller.
  Never create a root `index.html` or any `dir/index.html` (`build.py` and `validate.py` both refuse).
- `_guard.php`: 301s `www.` and plain http (from `X-Forwarded-Proto`, falling back to `HTTPS`) to
  `https://oregoninsuranceappraiser.com` (only on the real domain), 301s `/dir/index.php` and `/index.php` to the
  directory, sends `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow` on any other host (the preview), and returns 404 when requested directly.
- `index.php` (front controller): requires the guard, serves `home.html` for `/`, adds the trailing slash on directory
  URLs, includes `dir/index.php` for directory URLs that reach it, and returns `404.html` with a real 404 status.
- Verified locally with `tools/router.php` (interior page with `Host: www…` → 301; with `X-Forwarded-Proto: http` → 301;
  `/page/index.php` → 301 `/page/`) and on the preview URL.
- On preview URLs Hostinger serves its own Googlebot-blocking `robots.txt`; that's expected. Our `robots.txt` takes over on the real domain.
- `/home.html` itself is a real file and returns 200 directly; it is disallowed in `robots.txt` and its canonical is `/`.

## Google Search Console verification file

- File: `googlecccfbf2f7e9e5ae4.html` at the site root. Contents, exactly (one line, no newline, no HTML, no BOM):
  `google-site-verification: googlecccfbf2f7e9e5ae4.html`
- `build.py` writes it from the `GSC_FILE` / `GSC_BODY` constants on every build, so a rebuild never drops it.
  `validate.py` checks the bytes and keeps it out of page checks, `sitemap.xml`, the HTML site map and internal links;
  `robots.txt` doesn't block it.
- It must stay at the root permanently: Google re-checks it, and removing it unverifies the property. It works only for a
  **URL-prefix** property (`https://oregoninsuranceappraiser.com/`); a Domain property needs a DNS TXT record instead.
- Being a real file, the host serves it directly and the guard doesn't run for it (expected).

## Design

- Palette: navy `#002A86` (deep `#001B5E`, ink `#000F38`), flag yellow `#FFEA0F` (tint `#FFF8C4`), ember accent
  `#E4572E`, light tint `#EAF0FF`, warm paper `#F7F6F1`, ink text `#0E1630`.
- Fonts: **Bitter** (slab display) + **Rubik** (text) — not used by any sister site.
- Layout: floating pill header that goes solid on scroll; full-bleed parallax photo hero with a yellow-tabbed "ticket"
  lead form and a skewed yellow stripe; counter ledger; "six places a claim comes up short" cards; featured service photo
  cards + service row list; horizontal scroll-snap region strip; horizontal "appraisal trail" that fills on scroll;
  storm-record grid; city photo mosaic; three-role cards; parallax CTA; navy contact block. Square-ish cards with a
  yellow offset shadow + photo zoom on hover. Interior pages: photo hero, two columns with a sticky sidebar.
- Effects: scroll progress bar, solid-on-scroll header, hero/CTA parallax, staggered reveal, counters, hover zoom,
  trail fill, back-to-top. All respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; content renders fully without JavaScript.
- Mobile: off-canvas drawer **outside** the sticky header (left side, `min(360px, 86vw)` so the overlay stays tappable),
  accordion submenus, scroll lock, closes on ×, overlay tap, link tap or Escape, `inert`/`aria-hidden` handled, shadow
  only while open; fixed call bar at the bottom.
- Logo: navy tile, yellow Cascade peaks, white level line. Brand links don't change color on hover (header, drawer, footer).

## SEO rules enforced by validate.py

- Title ≤ 60 characters and ≤ ~580px (Arial metrics at 20px); titles unique
- Meta description **110–143 characters** (under 144), present exactly once, unique, ends with a full sentence, and
  identical to `og:description` and `twitter:description` — on every page including the 404
- Exactly one H1, first heading is the H1, no skipped levels (footer, sidebar boxes and tools included)
- Valid JSON-LD; every `@id` reference resolves
- No broken internal links or anchors; every image has `alt`
- Homepage main content mentions "Oregon Insurance Appraiser" ≥ 14 times (currently 19)
- No sister-state names in any text asset ("Washington" allowed only as "Washington County", the Oregon county)
- Every `dir/index.php` starts with the guard line and contains no other PHP; no `index.html` anywhere
- `sitemap.xml` URLs all map to pages; no 404/verification/photo-credits URLs; robots.txt doesn't block the GSC file

Schema per page: ProfessionalService (logo ImageObject, contactPoint, addressRegion OR / US, Oregon + 12 cities as
areaServed, OfferCatalog of services), WebSite, one page node (WebPage/AboutPage/ContactPage/CollectionPage) linked to
its BreadcrumbList, primaryImageOfPage and mainEntity; plus Service, FAQPage, ItemList, WebApplication, BlogPosting,
HowTo and DefinedTermSet where they apply. Every page has canonical, Open Graph (image size + alt), Twitter card and
`geo.region` US-OR.

## Contact form

`/api/contact.php`: honeypot, 5-per-10-minutes per-IP limit, validation (name + valid email or phone + consent).
It sends through `info@oregoninsuranceappraiser.com` over authenticated SMTP (`smtp.hostinger.com:465`) when
`api/_private/config.php` exists, falls back to `mail()`, and always appends a JSON line to
`api/_private/leads.log.php` (created on first use, starts with `<?php http_response_code(404); exit; ?>`).
Both private files return 404 when requested. They live under `public_html` because the file API can't write outside it.
**Credentials are never committed** (`_private/` is in `.gitignore`). When the mailbox password is available, upload:

```php
<?php
if (!defined('OIA_CONFIG_OK')) { http_response_code(404); exit; }
return ['smtp_host' => 'smtp.hostinger.com', 'smtp_port' => 465,
        'smtp_user' => 'info@oregoninsuranceappraiser.com', 'smtp_pass' => '…'];
```

then confirm `/api/_private/config.php` returns 404 with 0 bytes, send one submission labelled TEST, and confirm the log
line shows `"via":"smtp"`. Keep any local copy outside the repo and delete it after upload.

Done on Nov 17, 2026: config uploaded (local copy deleted), config URL 404 / 0 bytes, one TEST lead sent, log shows
`"via":"smtp","err":null`. To change the password, re-upload the file above.

## Google Tag Manager

`build.py` holds `GTM_ID = "GTM-5QHSTX3L"` and `GTM_HEAD`, the owner's snippet copied exactly. When `GTM_ID` is set,
the snippet goes in `<head>` and the `<noscript>` iframe right after `<body>` on every page; set it to `""` to remove both.

## When the nameservers point here (reference)

1. Check `agency-hosting_websites_get` → `ssl_cert.names` covers both the domain and `www.`; reissue with
   `agency-hosting_ssl_reinstall-website` if `www` is missing.
2. Check http, www and `/index.php` variants 301 to `https://oregoninsuranceappraiser.com/page/` on the home and 3+
   interior pages; every sitemap URL 200; no `X-Robots-Tag` on the real domain; our robots.txt served; GSC file 200, exact bytes.
   A www URL with 200 and `x-hcdn-cache-status: HIT` means a stale CDN copy: clear the cache again.
3. Verify the URL-prefix property in Search Console and submit `https://oregoninsuranceappraiser.com/sitemap.xml`.
